events.text:
T-272 is done: the two waiting lists Adi reads no longer contain any of the old `?k=` sign-in links. I committed the fix as e09b8393, pushed it to main, and acked note F-6449aa40.

- **WAITING_ON_ADI.md:** done. I replaced the 3 links (the T-335, T-336 and T-393 asks) with `https://revops-centre.growthcluborg.workers.dev/admin/enter` plus "paste the owner key from ~/.config/tantra/revops-admin-key into the form". A grep for `enter?k=` now finds 0.
- **WAITING_ON_ADI_GROUPED.md:** done. I made the same replacement in the 2 places (the Tantra API key section and line 43). A grep now finds 0.
- **Generator script:** none exists. I searched the repo's Python, shell and JS scripts and nothing writes these files, so I edited them by hand.
- **Left as they were:** inbox.jsonl, the old log lines and probe-admin-tokens.mjs.
- **Status:** I set T-272 to done with the counts in its note. Adi and Bharath are still the reviewers. I did not rebuild or redeploy anything, and I did not re-run the four done-when checks this run; they were confirmed live on 2026-10-11.
